issues.what: Block 2 shot 1 (0:07.3-0:11.0): an Apple-style bitten-apple logo is drawn on the loan officer's laptop lid (clearly visible 9.4-10.1 s and on the second laptop). Same defect as the 10-26 review.
issues.fix: threejs: block 2 shot 1. Replace the whole shot with a text-free three.js yield line: a glowing green line climbing inside a dark panel, overlay '10-YR TREASURY YIELD' from the assembler, 3.6 s. Fallback regen with 'unbranded laptops with plain matte lids'.

issues.what: Block 2 shot 1: the green line on the wall screen breaks into stray bright-green bars that leave the screen and float in the room. They hover at hip height beside and in front of the man (9.2-10.8 s) and pass over his torso, and the screen line duplicates at the top edge. Impossible physics.
issues.fix: threejs: block 2 shot 1. Same three.js line chart as above. If kept as video, use a regen with the motion prompt 'static wide shot, one green line slowly climbs inside the wall screen, nothing glows outside the screen', 4 s.

issues.what: Block 2 shot 2 (0:11.0-0:15.2): the red chart is redrawn each frame. The peaks sit in different places at 11.0, 12.0, 13.0 and 14.0 s, the line is doubled, and its tail fades out and changes. It never spikes off the top as scripted, so the 'highest since 2002' graphic is not a stable real data line. The crowd is also small and static.
issues.fix: threejs: block 2 shot 2. Three.js line of the 10-year yield rising to a dashed 2002-level marker and crossing it (text-free; the assembler's 'HIGHEST SINCE 2002' overlay supplies the words), 4.2 s.

issues.what: Block 1 shot 3 (0:05.1-0:07.3): the 'blank mortgage contract' is covered in AI-drawn text lines. An upside-down garbled heading shows at 5.3-5.7 s. Text drawn by the AI is a block, though this is the mildest of the three text-like cases.
issues.fix: regen: block 1 shot 3. Motion prompt: 'Close-up, a man's hand in a dark suit sleeve rests on a completely blank white sheet on a wooden desk, then slides off the sheet and out of frame; no printed text.' 3 s clip (needs 2.3 s).

issues.what: Block 3 shot 1 (0:15.2-0:19.8): the woman throws her head far back from 18.0 to 19.7 s. Her neck stretches, her face is hidden, and her torso grows and her belt appears (scale jump). A hard cut at 19.77 s snaps her back to looking down at the house.
issues.fix: trim: block 3 shot 1. Delete 0:17.5-0:19.77 and join 0:17.45 to 0:19.77. Both sides show her looking down with a hand near the house, so the clip stays about 3.5 s.

issues.what: Overlay '$400K LOAN AT 7.4%' sits across the woman's eyes in 0:15.7-0:21 (block 3 shot 1). Block 3 shots 1 and 2 together hold the same kitchen scene about 5.9 s before the jar appears.
issues.fix: trim: block 3 shot 1 overlay. Raise the overlay above her head (assembler overlay position) or show it for the first 1.5 s only.

issues.what: Block 3 shot 2 (0:21.2-0:26.4): the jar of coins is physically impossible. When the hand tips it (22.5-24.5 s), coins stream out through the glass wall mid-side and from below the rim, the pile on the counter grows far larger than the jar's contents, the jar still looks full at 24.0 s, then at about 25.0 s the jar is back upright and full with the counter pile gone. It is the owner's coins-through-the-jar example. The rolled banknote also carries AI-drawn print.
issues.fix: threejs: block 3 shot 2. Text-free three.js: an empty glass jar, coins fall in through the open top and pile up, then a second stack beside it shows the +$283 gap (two coin stacks of $2,486 vs $2,770). The assembler overlay supplies the numbers. 4.5 s (shorter than the 5.3 s now).

issues.what: Overlay '+$283 A MONTH' (0:21.5-0:26.4) differs from the voice 'about two hundred eighty dollars'. The $283 matches the Freddie Mac math, so only the rounding differs.
issues.fix: trim: block 3 shot 2 overlay (script.json overlay text). Change the overlay to '~$280 A MONTH' (caption edit, no regen).

issues.what: Block 4 shot 1 (0:26.4-0:30.0): the two hot-air balloons are not tied by a rope as scripted, so 'yield up, rates up' shows no cause and effect. The left balloon bends and tilts out of shape at 29.4-29.9 s. It holds 3.5 s.
issues.fix: threejs: block 4 shot 1. Text-free three.js: two balloons joined by a rope, the first rises, the rope goes taut and pulls the second up, 3.5 s (matches the scripted action). Cheaper fallback: trim to 0:26.4-0:29.0, which loses the metaphor.

issues.what: Block 4 shot 2 (0:30.0-0:34.0): the house keys duplicate. At 31.8-32.2 s she holds a bunch in her right hand while another is thrown above her head, then at 32.6-33.4 s both hands hold separate bunches. Her framing also jumps from a mid shot to a full-body walk.
issues.fix: regen: block 4 shot 2 (ref 1.1). Motion prompt: 'Static medium shot, the woman in the denim jacket smiles at the camera and gently jingles one set of keys in her right hand; left hand stays still; keys never leave her hand.' 4 s clip.

issues.what: The video ends on a 1.4 s loop frame of the shocked woman from the opening shot (34.0-35.4 s) right after the smiling 'knowing' beat, which contradicts the closing tone. There is no caption and no voice in this stretch.
issues.fix: trim: end hold. Hold the last frame of the regenerated keys shot instead of looping the hook frame.

issues.what: Block 1 shot 2 (steps, 0:03.2-0:05.1): the crowd sits and cries rather than shaking fists, and one seated man becomes a standing man pointing between 3.7 and 4.0 s. The pointing hand blurs at 4.7 s. This is borderline, not a block.
issues.fix: none: -. Re-check; optionally shorten to 1.5 s.

issues.what: Facts verified: 7.4% (Freddie Mac, 15 Oct), 10-year Treasury highest since 2002, $400,000 loan about $2,770 vs $2,486, difference about $283 (voice rounds to $280). Whisper small.en matches the script word for word. AI disclosure is in the YouTube description and publish_plan.
